content.doc_md:
❮ Math Methods

Themin()method returns the number with the lowest value from a pair of numbers.

Tip:Use themax()method to return the number with the highest value.

One of the following:

### Code Snippets

```
Example
Get the lowest value from different pairs of numbers:
System.out.println(Math.min(2.0, 0.25));
System.out.println(Math.min(31.2f, 18.0f));
System.out.println(Math.min(14, 22));
System.out.println(Math.min(96L, 2048L));
Try it Yourself »
```
